sourceRefs: live config claude2 runtime home=/home/lupin/.claude2 without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR

acceptance: Reproduce the live false negative: claude2 runtime sets HOME=/home/lupin/.claude2 but omits CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so the provider probe reads /home/lupin/.claude2/.claude/.credentials.json while the authenticated credentials are /home/lupin/.claude2/.credentials.json.
Add CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/home/lupin/.claude2 to the claude2 runtime environment in source config, preserving account isolation from Claude and without copying, exposing, or editing credentials.

Add regression coverage proving the configured claude2 probe environment resolves the intended credentials path and reports ready when the isolated auth material is present; prove Claude continues using its own config directory.
Run focused provider-permission tests, relevant supervisor tests, JSON validation, and git diff --check; commit evidence with all subjects <=72 characters and required trailers.

Keep this source-only: no live config edit, no direct auth pause clearing, no credential rotation, no provider/account regrouping, no reviewer-policy or scheduler change. After merge, supervisor must perform the live auth probe and clear the stale pause transactionally.
